svg.title: Paname
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; not a facsimile. E.ON institutional collection publication supplies an actual color installation photograph and explicitly calls Paname black-and-white. Exact five white intrusions transcribed from the full1973frontal plate; reflections in the later glazed installation are excluded. White areas are painted rectangular support, not missing canvas.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.kunst-im-blauen-haus.de/img/aktuell/EON_Art.pdf#page=7; record moma1973-pdf71-caption1; visual review 2026-10-28. Pure-vector study.
